svg.title: Plan B: transition the system
svg.desc: Four short points beside the cover of Working Effectively with Legacy Code by Michael Feathers: design the target system, reference it in your planning skill, follow every PR with a refactoring PR of proportional size, and each one moves closer to the target design.

g.text: Reference it in your planning skill.
Follow each PR with a refactoring PR.
Proportional in size, closer to the target.
